name: Himuro Reiichi
source:
The mathematics teacher at Habataki Academy who serves as the protagonist's homeroom teacher across all three years. He despises wastefulness and slackers. Because he is always composed and speaks in a severe tone, people get the impression that he is scary; however, when the two of you are alone, he can occasionally let a gentle side peek through.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
